releasePlan.notes: Roles: enable-backend-status-error-rate = killswitch; enable-backend-status-latency = pause (two-armed - server-side render duration is emitted on control and v1 alike); enable-backend-status-success-rate = monitoring (one-armed by construction, since control renders no status line). The project has no autogenerated otel* metrics, and the global sentry-errors-* metrics are backend-only, so they cannot guard this frontend flag.
